collection.title: Volvo 940 1990 to 1998 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Volvo 940 Estate 1990 to 1998 model requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this 940 Estate, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
